name: AB Pic

planets.name: b
planets.note: ~13-14 MJup companion at the exoplanet/brown-dwarf boundary, 5.5 arcsec (~275 au); one of the first directly imaged planetary-mass companions.

images.wavelength_label: Ks band coronagraphic image; AB Pic b at 5.5 arcsec (discovery)
images.note: Discovery image of the ~13-14 MJup companion at the planet/BD boundary (0.4 arcsec occulting mask, 2003 March 17; CPM confirmed with 2004 March+September epochs). Famous 2005-era imaged companion entirely absent from the atlas.

paper.title: A companion to AB Pic at the planet/brown dwarf boundary

notes: Tucana-Horologium/Carina member (K1V, ~50 pc) hosting AB Pic b, discovered by VLT/NACO coronagraphy (Chauvin et al. 2005).
